scope: Additional primary-source visual studies from 2025–2026; figure-level design observations, not a ranking of research quality.
counting_policy: Count one underlying paper/report once across versions and one numbered/descriptive figure anchor once. Subpanels and SVG assets composing the same inspected figure are not extra papers. Use original submission/publication year and one primary corporate family; preserve collaborating affiliations in each record.
evidence_policy: Source PDFs or official native SVGs were inspected visually; text-only or abstract-only search results are not counted as inspected figures.
Keep vector measurements, declared SVG styles, rendered raster samples, visual estimates, and production recommendations distinct.
Ignore invisible search/OCR layers when identifying visible fonts. Outlined/raster text without other evidence has an unverified family.
Retain raw color and opacity; rendered appearance may differ from raw PDF RGB. Do not publish transform-anomalous widths as physical stroke thickness.
Source font sizes and coordinates describe the inspected placement. Small labels are evidence, not recommended production defaults.
artifact_policy: Raw source PDFs, SVGs, rendered crops, and intermediate inspection JSON are not redistributed. Artifact basenames in evidence records identify study intermediates. Reproduce a study from the primary URL/version, PDF hash, one-based page, and crop bounds; use native asset URLs for web figures.

synthesis.use: A real multi-stage pipeline with different operations, intermediate data and meaningful outputs.

synthesis.name: Multimodal overview with one expanded operation
synthesis.use: Models with multiple token/hidden-state types and one important fusion/generation mechanism.
synthesis.observed_basis: Overview/detail split; stable stream colors; short token ribbons; semantically separate residual/conditioning routes; expanded attention or codebook generation.
synthesis.composition: Use a compact input example and grouped token ribbon in the overview; reserve almost half the width for the new mechanism. Use dashed, arrowless expansion boundaries and named colored data routes.
synthesis.caution: The source red/cyan fills are translucent. Use the rendered pastel or retain alpha. Do not import raster-only font identities or copy source logos.

synthesis.name: Persistent memory beneath a streaming computation
synthesis.use: Streaming agents, chunked generation, retrieval/replay, or memory-augmented distillation.
synthesis.observed_basis: A persistent lower memory ribbon, repeated current-step groups, separate retrieval and update corridors, and matched memory-index matrices.
synthesis.composition: Give memory a continuous physical region and each time step a bounded current computation. Label read, write and loss paths separately. Use a matrix inset only when index selection itself is the contribution.
synthesis.caution: The source artwork is rasterized; the sampled colors are approximate rendered tokens, and proposed dimensions/fonts are new design recommendations.

synthesis.name: Data-flow quantity contract
synthesis.rule: A Sankey-like ribbon invites a quantitative reading. Use widths only for known flows with units and conservation checks; otherwise use an explicitly schematic branch graph. Show reject paths without implying measured fractions. Stage-specific color is acceptable when named as stage role, but it does not track persistent cohort identity.

synthesis.name: Phase-aware dash vocabulary
synthesis.rule: Even within one report, a dashed line can mean training-only in one figure and optional in another. Derive line-style semantics from each caption; define a local legend and keep that meaning consistent inside the delivered figure set.

synthesis.name: Physical plausibility before trusting extraction
synthesis.rule: Validate extracted geometry against rendered appearance and region scale. Treat enormous raw drawing widths as untrusted metadata, invisible text as search/OCR metadata, and transparency as part of a color. Record a visible font as unknown when only outlines or raster lettering exist.

synthesis.name: Do not inherit poor source legibility
synthesis.rule: Prestigious reports still contain 3.6–5 pt diagram labels. Use their grouping and comparison grammar while enlarging text, removing a full transcript, replacing repeated operations with counts, or adding a detail panel.
